_note: SpeedKills' ten hacks (src/game/hacks.ts, main.ts useHack and stepHacks): one mobility and one utility, picked before the match; in the battle royale a copy found on the floor fuses (a level up, to fuseLevels) and another of the same slot swaps. Phase 20 A9, the owner: work exactly as Hyper Scape's did, from sources, not assumption. So `cooldowns` (seconds at fusion levels 0 to 4) and the other numbers are Hyper Scape's FINAL published values (patch notes to v3.1; checked word for word against their sources by the Phase 20 research, 71 of 72 quotes confirmed): Teleport (our DASH) 12/11/10/9/7; Slam 12/11/10/9/7, damage 20 at every level and 30 at the top; Heal 14/13/12/11/9, 4.4 health a second (6.6 at the top) for 9 s; Armor 14/13/12/11/9, 4 s; Wall 12/11/10/9/7, 15 s, at most 2; Invisibility 14/13/12/11/9, 4 s, broken by firing, aiming in or another hack; Reveal 12/11/10/9/7, a 50 degree cone out to 60 m for 8 s; Mine 14/13/12/11/9, damage 40 and 60 at the top, it chases an enemy within 15 m for up to 8 s, armed in 0.75 s, at most 1. No source published two numbers, so they were MEASURED off gameplay footage (Phase 20, against a training dummy of known height and the floor's tiles, credible to about 15%): Slam's apex, about 30 m above take-off (26 to 36; one player's claim was also 30), and Teleport's reach, about 26 m (23 to 31) the way you look, up included. Ours, kept: LEAP and GRAPPLE (no Hyper Scape counterpart); ARMOR takes 60% of a hit away and lets you shoot, the owner's earlier choice (Hyper Scape's made you invulnerable and unable to shoot); Slam's hang, fall speed and radius, and the Mine's chase speed and blast radius, which no source gives. Sources: the Hyper Scape Fandom wiki (via its API), Ubisoft's patch notes and news (Wayback copies), devtrackers.gg, pcgamesn.com, gamepur.com, thegamer.com, hotspawn.com; footage: YouTube S9OdObH8V9k (Slam) and 2ckLUqY2RdQ (Teleport). The keys: mobility on the ability key (F, a pad's LB), utility on the grenade key (G, a pad's RB), since SpeedKills carries no grenades.
_healArea: How HEAL's area looks (src/game/healarea.ts), after Hyper Scape's: a ring on the ground with arcs turning inside it (one turn in `spin` s, at `arcs` shares of the radius), a low wall of light `wall` m tall fading up at `opacity` (a squad mate's, an enemy's), and `plus` signs rising round it (how many, their size in metres, how high they rise and a rise's seconds). While you stand in one and it heals you, `screen` of the view's edges glows green and the "+" rises there too (hud.ts drawHealing). Ours, by eye.
